NGA.note: Digital sovereignty is mentioned as a theme of the Online Harm Protection Bill; no rule or policy on state data is stated.
Advocacy for Policy and Innovation is described as an organiser and advocate, not as a research institution, and no research is stated.

facts.fact: NITDA reports that it and Advocacy for Policy and Innovation held a multi-stakeholder workshop in Abuja on the draft Online Harm Protection Bill with policymakers, civil society organisations, technology leaders, legal experts and academics.
